title: The City Fed from the Air: Berlin's Four Hundred Sixty-Two Days
summary: Tells how, on June twenty-fourth, nineteen forty-eight, the Soviets closed every land and water route into West Berlin, and how a city of two million was fed for fifteen months by aircraft alone, through just three air corridors. The episode ranges from the day of chaos on August thirteenth, nineteen forty-eight, to Tunner's system that turned the planes into an assembly line, to the Tegel runway that Berliners built with their own hands in ninety days, and to the blockade splitting Germany in two and giving birth to NATO.
